title: Preservation of arbitrary scheme-universe coproducts by shared derived tensorRight
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], with any chosen derived category $D(\mathcal O_X)$ in localization universe w [def-pc-derived-category] and its shared K-flat derived tensor [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. For every derived object E and every index type J in the scheme universe u, the functor $(-)\otimes^{\mathbb L}E$ preserves colimits of shape Discrete J. The universes u and w are independent, no quasi-coherence of E is required, and the empty index type is allowed.

source.place: Tag 0A9U, first two sentences of proof; Cohomology Tags 06YH and 0FPB; Injectives Tag 07D9

proof.text: Install the exact module-sheaf tensor, symmetry, closedness, additivity, Grothendieck abelianness in universe u, and functorial flat resolutions used by the shared derived tensor construction. The upstream K-flat localizer morphism is a left derivability structure. Grothendieck abelianness supplies K-injective resolutions, independently of the localization universe w.

For P = Qh.objPreimage E, form H = internalHom P followed by Qh, R = its total right derived functor, and its unit eta. Use the existing DerivedCategory.tensorLeftQhObjCounit epsilon. Its components are invertible on K-flat objects, so tensorLeft(Qh P) followed by R is left derived for the whiskered epsilon. The components of eta are invertible on K-injectives, so R followed by tensorLeft(Qh P) is right derived for the whiskered eta. Apply Adjunction.derived to HomotopyCategory.tensorHomAdjunction P. Transport the resulting adjunction along Qh.objObjPreimageIso E. This proves tensorLeft E is a left adjoint using only Grothendieck abelianness in u; it does not invoke the bundled closed instance requiring Grothendieck abelianness in w. These are applications of the already proved upstream derivability and derived-adjunction API, as detailed by DerivedCategory/Monoidal/Closed.lean.

Specialize the simultaneous naturality of the existing derived symmetry to the identity of E and any f:K to L. This assembles s(E,K) into a natural isomorphism tensorLeft E to tensorRight E. A left adjoint preserves colimits of every shape by Mathlib; transport preservation across this natural isomorphism and specialize to Discrete J. There is no nonempty-family assumption, so empty coproducts are included.
